records.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options
records.summary: Missing nosniff is a low-priority browser hardening observation when supplied headers lack the control.
records.remediation_summary: Send X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff where compatible with the application.
safe_next_steps: Review response header baseline and add the control during normal hardening work.

records.title: Source Map Reference Hint
records.summary: A supplied source map reference is an inventory signal only. Accessibility was not checked.
records.remediation_summary: Review build publishing rules and ensure unintended development artifacts are not published.
safe_next_steps: Inspect deployment configuration with the owner; do not fetch referenced artifacts in this task.

records.title: Sample KEV-Style Admin Surface Prioritization
records.summary: A local sample record demonstrating that known-priority intelligence can raise review priority when admin surfaces overlap with missing frame controls.
records.remediation_summary: Prioritize owner review of frame restrictions for administrative and authentication surfaces.
safe_next_steps: Use owner-provided context to decide whether a future low-impact validation is appropriate.

records.title: Sample EPSS-Style API Auth Review Priority
records.summary: A local sample record demonstrating how a high probability-like priority hint can raise API authorization review priority without confirming a weakness.
records.remediation_summary: Review API authentication intent and documentation before any active validation.
safe_next_steps: Keep the next step to documentation and scope review until approved validation exists.

records.title: Sample CVE-Style Framework Inventory Record
records.summary: A local sample record showing how an explicitly disclosed framework can be linked to future advisory review without claiming impact.
records.remediation_summary: Track disclosed technologies in inventory and review versions against approved knowledge sources in a future task.
safe_next_steps: Do not infer affected status without version-specific owner-approved intelligence.
